card.name: "Not for" route restrictions on topical labels
card.fires_on: The word "Not" (or "is not") starting a short restriction after "for external/topical use only", as in "Not for ophthalmic use". It also fires on "not recommended" in label warnings.

modes.label: Not for other routes
modes.description: "Not" opens a sentence listing routes the product must not be used by, right after a topical-use statement.
modes.example: PRECAUTIONS: For external use only.<< Not>> for ophthalmic use. Product and

modes.label: Not recommended / not intended
modes.description: "not" or "IS" before "NOT intended" or "recommended" in a warning about a patient group or use.
modes.example: [see Adverse Reactions ( 6.2 )] . Because of its constipating effects, colesevelam hydrochloride is<< not>> recommended in patients with gastroparesis

card.writes: It pushes toward words like "suitable" and "suited", as in "not suitable for", and away from unrelated code-like pieces.
card.plain: It marks the word "not" that begins a statement of what a product is not meant for, such as eye or oral use.
